description: This file implements the methods of the IpcClientControllerImpl class and related factory functions within the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace. It manages RPC controller state, including resetting, failure status, error messages, and handling method call failures. It also includes factory creation logic for IPC controllers.

classes.name: ClientControllerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the RPC client controller managing call state, failure status, and cancellation (not implemented).

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new ClientControllerImpl instance.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the controller's failure state and reason string to initial values.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Returns whether the last RPC call failed.

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message if the last call failed.

methods.name: StartCancel
methods.description: Logs a warning that cancellation is not implemented.

methods.name: setMethodCallFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure state and reason string when a method call fails, either from a string or formatted message.
